provenance.text: Items are the owner's stored news plus the latest items of the enabled feeds (10 Oct 2026). Each item was labelled independently by three AI models (the Claude coding assistant, gemini-3.8-flash, gpt-6.1-sol); the stored label is the majority vote on every field, and three-way event-type splits were settled by the coding assistant. A second review pass by the coding assistant re-read the disputed items against one rule (an item is relevant only if it names a held company or is a US or euro-area central-bank or inflation item) and changed 10 event types and 41 relevance flags. No human reviewed the labels. Treat results on this set as a regression gate, not as proof of accuracy.

CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
items.summary: The Cross-Market Operational Resilience Group (CMORG) yesterday (8 October 2026) completed its biennial simulation exercise, known as SIMEX26, focused this year on a global cloud services disruption.

items.headline: Bank of England announces the four animals that will feature on our next series of banknotes
items.summary: The Atlantic puffin, barn owl, buff-tailed bumblebee and European hedgehog will represent UK wildlife and feature as the central images on our next series of banknotes.

items.headline: Minutes of the London FXJSC Legal Sub Committee Meeting – 16 June 2026
items.summary: The Bank of England provides the Secretariat to the London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC) Legal Sub-Committee. The FXJSC is made up of market participants, infrastructure providers and the UK financial regulators.

items.headline: Minutes of the London FXJSC Operations Sub-Committee Meeting – 16 June 2026
items.summary: The Bank of England chairs the London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC) Operations and Legal Sub-Committees. The FXJSC is made up of market participants, infrastructure providers and the UK financial regulators.

items.headline: Invitation to bid – Federal Treasury discount paper (Bubills)
Announcement of a multi-ISIN auction – Reopening of two Federal bonds
Auction result– Federal bond issue
Announcement of auction– Reopening of five-year Federal notes (Bundesobligationen – “Bobls”) series 194 by auction
Bank of Canada Board launches process to fill external Deputy Governor position
items.summary: The Board of Directors of the Bank of Canada has initiated a recruitment process to fill the external Deputy Governor position left vacant by the appointment of Nicolas Vincent as a full-time Deputy Governor.

items.headline: Bank of Canada unveils new vertical $20 bank note
items.summary: Her Excellency the Right Honourable Louise Arbour, Governor General of Canada, and the Honourable Wayne Long, Secretary of State (Canada Revenue Agency and Financial Institutions), joined Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem today at an event to unveil Canada’s new vertical $20 bank note featuring a portrait of His Majesty King Charles III.

items.headline: Bank of Canada maintains the policy rate at 2¼%
items.summary: The Bank of Canada today held its target for the overnight rate at 2.25%, with the Bank Rate at 2.5% and the deposit rate at 2.20%.

items.headline: G7 2026 Cross-Border Coordination Exercise (CBCE)
items.summary: The G7 Cyber Expert Group (CEG) successfully concluded its 2026 Cross-border coordination exercise (CBCE) on May 18, 2026. This exercise demonstrates the Group’s ongoing commitment to strengthening cyber resilience across the G7 financial sector.
